release_notes: Bugfix release built from a 22-item audit of a live Facebook-Ads COD setup. Cost attribution now matches spend in the ad account's own timezone instead of UTC (an Asia/Kolkata account reconciles to zero unmatched for the first time) and skips safe-page (cloaked crawler) clicks, with a fallback for crawler-only periods. campaign_report honors the safe-page exclusion the rest of the panel already applied, fixing a 4x click overstatement. Facebook/TikTok CAPI: conversions skipped for an unmapped or shadowed status now leave a log line instead of vanishing; the Pixel Vault test button tests every real transport the profile is attached to, including its proxy; curl pins IPv4 and gets a 10s connect budget (graph.facebook.com's unroutable AAAA records no longer read as resolver failures); the queue worker ships scheduled by install.sh. Timezone work: Campaigns and the Conversions Log actually send ?timezone=, one shared timezone store keeps every mounted view and the dashboard on the same zone, and report offsets are anchored to the queried range instead of now (DST-correct for any range inside one period). A worker-health banner surfaces a missing queue worker, an unscheduled aggregator and shadowed conversion statuses before they cost data. Panel: modals layer above the navbar again (z-index 2000 scale), column widths persist through Chrome's lostpointercapture/pointerup race, Landings headers are sortable via the shared SortableTh module, entity ids no longer leak into Offers' metric columns, totals footers align with body cells, zero conversions no longer render in success green, SQLite 0/1 flags no longer print as stray zeros, and the campaign name suggestion is idempotent.
